notes.title: Nominate Bossgard for the "Better with Friends" award!
notes.content:
Hear ye, hear ye, the Steam Awards are yet again upon us! To that end we've set off to do battle for the most important title there is (in-our-honest-opinion) - the "Better with friends" award!

There are plenty of games that you can enjoy by your lonesome, but for Bossgard multiplayer is where it's at! After all, there's nothing like crushing your friends with a giant slice of bread. And there's nothing like being the last man standing in your 5-man Viking team who miraculously revives everybody back into   fighting condition, only to see the tide of battle turn to your favor. Glorious.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/8b064a3bed835922b27956aa5fa4d1350abaffae.png[/img]
That's what Bossgard is all about - great tales of even greater heroism! Heroes fighting against all odds, legendary gloating villains that take great pleasure in crushing the meek, that one godly sword slash landed in the nick of time which inevitably wins the match. 

Bossgard was designed for this. But hey, maybe Bossgard is a novel concept for you, so here's a breakdown:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/1e206975d0fa48a9bb49a4e945601e1e02978a85.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Bossgard is a 5v1 multiplayer boss battler where heroic Vikings face off against ridiculous titans known as Bosses.
[*] Play the Boss and be the one to pound your friends and foes into the ground with an arsenal of epic powers.
[*] Play one of the Vikings and work together in a party of heroes, each with their own powers.
[*] Deploy turrets, command pets, raise the Undead and crush your enemies with staggering mighty blows.
[*] Play as a giant slice of toast, an oversized plunger, a long-legged Viking huntress or a century-old babushka necromancer.
[*] Play online, locally or both alongside your best friends in 2v1, 3v1, 4v1 and 5v1 matches.
[*] Customize your Viking with sexy cosmetic gear to set your character apart from the rest.
[*] Go Viking against Viking and fight a battle where the odds are even.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/5153cdc96bbcf9954d9fdb40553ae6b6036589ba.png[/img]
Bossgard is like a super tight dose of boss-crushing action delivered in one hit. It's meant to be played with friends. It's meant to make you gloat. It's made to make you grit your teeth. It's made to have you shout in joy as you face off against insurmountable odds.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/e17abc87ccd5e18aaea3e61307f536680b0ae13e.png[/img]
It's better with friends. If you don't believe us, enjoy the [b]20% off[/b] and see for yourself. Yeah, that's right, we're so cocky we'll throw in a discount to prove our point. That's the Viking way. And the cyclopean-bread way.

Jokes aside, we're glad to have you here and hope to see you in-game!

Lovingly,
[i]The Sand Sailors
[/i]

notes.title: Update: In-game chat now available!
notes.content:
Get ready to scream “res pls”, “gg” and “gl hf” during Bossgard’s epic boss fights. Coordinate with your friends, look for players and make friends using our [b]brand-new chat system![/b]

[i]-the Sand Sailors[/i]

notes.title: Patch: Fixing the Hog
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/5cc0302ec6dc917efeb6f2ff578005b04ef23937.png[/img]

Hi there!

We received reports of faulty mechanized assault pigs and we had to do something about it. Upon closer inspection it became clear that the Warhog's Ragnarok-Class Reinforced Armor came under too much pressure from sustained fire and corrosive Poison arrows.

The Vikings seem to have developed a knack for landing Mighty Blows in the Warhog's armor weak points, especially where several moving parts would meet, like the joints and even the rotating autocannon.

Sustained damage during the first phase of the battle comprised the deployment of the phase II combat kit. We've also noticed severe damage to the Warhog's central processing unit. 

Several hog-handlers, like [h3]Papi[/h3] and [h3]Penk[/h3] (to whom we give our thanks) have reported an inability to control the Warhog in its second stage. Luckily, the warmachine's emergency security protocols deployed successfully and Vikings were unable the damage the unit, leading to postponing the battle altogether. 

[h3]Papi and Penk will receive 3000 Gold each for their honorable service. They should find a nice Gift Chest next time they login into Bossgard.[/h3]

We appologize to all our hog handlers, the new models are now fully outfitted with new, state-of-the-art armor and central processors. In the name of the Evil Eye, you should have no problem tearing the Vikings apart. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/0f1d8a130a7cb195e27037139aa510a9bd3383df.png[/img]
Proceed with the extermination of all Viking lifeforms and report any other issues you might encounter.

Hail the Eye.

[i]-the Sand Sailors[/i]

notes.title: Update: Fixes, improvements, and news!
notes.content:
[h3]Hail you Vikings! Hail you Bosses![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/fe12dc29b9839aeb68ce1aff093260ae4b805f7e.png[/img]
It’s been a great couple of weeks since Bossgard left Early Access! Glad to see some new faces in our community, we hope you’re here to stay! 

So! We’re back with another update, this time a good ol’ fashioned bug bashing routine plus several quality-of-life improvements!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/17c81c4bc468b24b7ad0c9762eee935c155bb106.png[/img]
[h3]Here’s what’s up:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added new camera angles for the 2v1, 3v1, 4v1 Boss Vs Vikings game lobby.
[*] Updated the localization for French, Spanish and German
[*] Modified how map voting works. Map voting is now based on a common map pool drawn from all the maps unlocked/owned by the players in the lobby. Previously the game only drew maps from the Host’s map pool.
[*] Improved reassignment after controller disconnect
[*] Bhaar-Boot no longer damages players behind him when rolling
[*] Vikings can now be rotated in the Main Menu.
[*] Tweaked Bot AI. AI characters now change targets as soon as their current target dies.
[*] Changed the order in which players join slots in Viking vs Viking modes
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/1bff60249c3459724fc02a5df5c08cad5c5087cd.png[/img]
[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed fonts for Russian language
[*] Fixed some totems becoming invulnerable after being killed
[*] Fixed Bhaar-Boot sometimes remaining stuck on top of a minion
[*] Fixed menu scaling for server list menu
[*] Fixed bow strings getting glitchy in main menu
[*] Fixed Magnus and Krampus gold skins not being displayed properly
[/list]
[h2]
We’re out of Gold![/h2]

Alas, the time to make merry is behind us and our anniversary Gold Skins are now off the table. Congratulations to all who got the chance to redeem these anniversary swag items. If you didn’t get your chance, no worries - there will be plenty of other opportunities. We’re certainly not out of reasons to celebrate - Bossgard is coming to the Nintendo Switch and Sony PS4 in July, so hang on tight!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/c00e8cea903e2e59e359bcbd40c03212a0b2a8cd.png[/img]

This is our main focus at the moment, finishing up the Switch and Playstation 4 builds so we can stay on track with our schedule. Our target is early July, we'll announce the exact date in the next couple of weeks.

That's it for now! See you in-game and stay tuned for more info, we'll make sure to keep you posted.

Bossgard awaits!

[i]-The Sand Sailors[/i]

We’re super happy to announce that Bossgard is getting close to the end of the Early Access program.
At the moment we're hard at work cooking the upcoming Switch and PS4 ports, drawing up promo assets and making sure that everything is in place for the grand finale of Bossgard’s Early Access and the grand opening of Bossgard to the rest of the gamers out there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/93fa01795405a77b2aa2ddc08a587040722544c2.png[/img]

[h3]Our big launch day will be the 28th of May and it will involve a lot of buzz, streaming, giveaways and discounts, so do make sure you tune in and tell your friends![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/481c82acf2a9374d334ec8c45708de3b3ab4c744.png[/img]

It’s been an amazing past year, we’ve learned more than we could’ve ever hoped for and your support and feedback have been critical to our development. To our Early Access players go our deepest thanks. 

[h2]Bossgard on Nintendo Switch and PS4[/h2]

Bossgard is coming to Nintendo Switch and PS4! All game versions will be almost identical, with some slight platform-specific differences:
[list]
[*] The PS4 version max number of local players will be 4. 
[*] The Nintendo Switch version will allow up to 6 local players to play together using Joy Con™ controllers. 
[*] All versions will support cross-platform play.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/e8f8668b91d49b072ab4055cd57b0dd106542f05.png[/img]

[h1]Major Content Update[/h1]
This new version of Bossgard will extend the roster of Vikings to a total of 10. Each of the new Vikings opens up new playstyles and combinations. We believe that more ways to bring down Bosses are always welcome.

Meet the new members of the crew:

[h3]Maksim[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/c0213ad4b1348216901c2df9e8f1d272028039be.png[/img]
Maksim is the Viking heavy-hitter. He’s ready to take a punch and respond in kind. He is a tormented Russian Viking, haunted by the Cheeki Breeki, an ungodly spirit that empowers Maksim, allowing him to turn into a Boss-sized demonic giant.

Makism’s attacks involve a series of strong jabs followed by a swift kick. He’s also able to lob boulders at enemies that prove to be out of his fist’s range. He’s an ideal candidate for anybody looking to play the role of a sturdy, reliable Tank.

[h3]Brunhilde[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/9cd983ffbb7c9708a79662204ff887ac195d6bcc.png[/img]
She’s the German Bard-of-Bards, Midgard’s very own Valkyrie, handy with both the spear and the lute. Brunhilde is a ranged Viking specialized in throwing spears at her enemies. Besides her spear, Brunhilde boasts a proud shield which she keenly uses to absorb damage AND throw it back at her assailants to great effect.

Should push come to shove, Brunhilde is ready to drop traditional armament and start banging on her lute, sending deadly soundwaves against her foes. If you’d like to Tank but Melee combat isn’t your thing, Brunhilde is there to scratch that itch.

[h3]Duke[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/b74c01afeec6d33500ea82b1e5db909e927261d8.png[/img]
The one and only true dude, the one and only true bro - Duke is the slick American Viking who’ll pick his surfboard and his hair gel over battle axes any day of the week. He’s a Ranger that likes zooming across the battlefield on his trusty board, pincushioning his enemies with javelins. 

When the vibe’s right, Duke is able to catch a wave and surf continuously, becoming virtually impossible to catch. If you’re all about mobility, Duke’s your guy.

[h3]Krampus[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/f341d4e5a0abe4219134c53b102aabba89fb603b.png[/img]
Krampus is… special. He’s not from around here, but he grew up in Midgard. Nobody understands his gibberish, but his enthusiasm and energy are unmatched. He’s mighty handy with the Greataxe and quite ingenious too. Because he’s short, he had to adapt. He relies on his grapple-hook-axe to close any gaps between him and his enemies. He can be proper pesky for mobile opponents. 

He is also able to deploy a melee axe turret - the Shredder, allowing him to secure areas of the battlefield with ease. Krampus is above all a Melee Specialist, there to fill weaknesses in a team’s composition.

[h3]Ziggy[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/7fdbc2489fffef0805085a7c163e4ffd5d9a6f12.png[/img]
The green thumb of the crew, Ziggy’s all about keeping it cool and not breaking a sweat. His twin throwing axes keep his enemies at bay. His signature criss-cross boomerang throw clears foes over large areas. He’s also quite the gardener, being able to instantly grow giant mushrooms that create organic walls through which he and his teammates can fire projectiles - literal mushroom bunkers. Ziggy’s here to limit the Boss’ ability to maneuver, all of this from a safe distance. He’s the team’s Ranged Specialist.

[h2]New Boss![/h2]
Besides these colourful additions to the team we’re also deploying our deadliest Boss yet: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/0f1d8a130a7cb195e27037139aa510a9bd3383df.png[/img]

The Warhog is Ragnarok incarnate. A mechanical abomination designed to deal as much damage as possible, as quickly as possible.

He is a mobile Boss, able to walk across the battlefield. His melee attack is a double swipe with his massive sword - the Siegeblade.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/d81bcf8d5ff2176bf2f0377457724e4cf9671423.png[/img]

He also boasts a ranged attack - his heavy autocannon, with which he can use to shower the Vikings with bullets. He is balanced and adaptable, with no obvious weaknesses. The Vikings will have to find windows of opportunity by exploiting his turn rate and melee attack speed. Both his attacks have windup times, giving time to dodge or close in on him.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/a06af5008899b7c13b5e67a20ede0edd28454026.png[/img]

He can heal himself by deploying repair stations, but be warned - they drop in on the battlefield in the form of bombs. The Warhog will have to make sure he is in range of these Repair Stations in order to benefit from them.

Warhog’s trump card is his Rocket Barrage Rage Attack, which allows him to fire his shoulder launcher, bombarding a large area of the battlefield with missiles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/5cc0302ec6dc917efeb6f2ff578005b04ef23937.png[/img]

The Warhog was designed as a straight-up badass Boss, less funny business, more firepower. You’ll be able to unlock the Warhog using Gold.

[h2]Special Launch Day Goodies[/h2]
During our big launch week we'll be hosting special "Play With the Devs" streams and organizing giveaways, so make sure you tune in on launch day for an opportunity to win game keys and other goodies, like the anniversary limited-edition Gold Skin, usable on all Vikings and Bosses by those who play during the launch event!

[h2]Price Increase[/h2]
We increased the price of the game to $19.99. This new price reflects all the work that's been done on the game since we’ve first launched the Early Access, including a lot of stuff that wasn’t initially part of the plan. With this current update we've brought the game's content to an almost final state. We've doubled the number of playable Vikings and added a new unique Boss. Our final pre-launch efforts will be focused on the console ports and preparing everything needed for the big day. 

Thank you again for all the support, Bossgard came a really long way and it has become bigger and better in every way since we’ve launched the Early Access. Stay tuned for more news and see you on the big day! May 28! 

And stay safe!

[i]
-The Sand Sailors
[/i]

P.S. Remember to join our Discord server! If you have any questions or curiosities, you can get in touch with us [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/vgez3YH]here![/url]

notes.title: Ew! Bugs!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/7ce1fea86959cf168503d1a6ca1cb4621eb96da4.png[/img]
[h2]Hail you Vikings, hail you Bosses![/h2]

Here we are, sharpening our blades and cleaning our wounds after a mighty battle with 2019. As yesteryear’s songs quiet down, we look full of anticipation towards the 20th year of the 2nd millennium and since it’s customary for humans to utter the phrase “new year, new me” during this time of year, we shall begin with a bit of renewing of our own…

...by smashing some nasty bugs from 2019!

Several of the issues covered in the update have been previously pointed out by some of our users, hopefully their game experience and yours will be much better as of yesterday.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/841709a288ebb2de8e603051786b95597b2866e5.png[/img]
[h2][b]Fixed Issues:[/b][/h2]

[b]Keyboard Mapping[/b]

Users reported that sometimes they would be unable to remap certain actions in the game, especially those tied to Movement. Mapping should work correctly now.
[b]
Steam Invites[/b]

A high number of players reported that they were unable to invite their friends to their lobby via the Steam Friend Invite system, especially in cross-region play. You should now be able to invite like a Boss. Figure of speech, it works for Vikings as well…

[b]“OMG NERF BHAAR-BOOT”[/b]

Bhaar-Boot has been under heavy fire from our users for being overpowered and although our game stats indicate that Bhaar-Boot’s win/lose ratio isn’t worrisome, we have been testing what people say and yes, there are a few ways you can cheese your enemies using Bhaar-Boot. To that extent we have nerfed Bhaar-Boot, we have reduced his rage gain per hit, so fights against him should feel a lot more balanced.

For those of you interested in numbers, here’s a breakdown:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/583af44788c9779ad5322f570a1bd6f00477ec8c.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Melee Rage gain has been dropped from 10 to 5 units (-50%)
[*] His Upgraded Melee Rage gain has been dropped from 25 to 15 (-60%)
[*] Tongue Rage gain has been dropped from 20 to 10 (-50%)
[*] Stage 2 Tongue Rage gain has been increased from 10 to 15 (+33.33%)
[*] Projectile (Stage 2 Shockwave Trails) Rage gain has been dropped from 10 to 8 (-20%)
[/list]

As reference, Bhaar-Boot’s full Rage bar holds 1400 Rage points. Bhaar-Boot’s Rage costs 1000 Rage points.

Well this has been it, thank you for all the feedback, keep on reporting, killing bugs. Your weapons have been fixed, get back into the fray!

-The Sand Sailors

REMEMBER! If you'd like to stay in touch or have something you'd like ourselves or others to hear ASAP, head over to our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/vgez3YH]DISCORD[/url] server!

notes.title: Update: Survival 1.0
notes.content:
The Steam Awards are right around the corner and we'd super appreciate it if you'd consider nominating us! Personally, we'd go for the "Better with Friends" award but who are we to judge? That's a job for you people!

[h1]Back to Bossgard[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/101e2ccfba3810f1f5c4e8afe8d6590b4bcaa37f.jpg[/img]
Tree planting, scorekeeping, extensive balancing and a bit of storytelling, these are the main things covered in our latest update. Just like our last few updates, this one’s about the singleplayer Adventure mode. 

[h1]Making the world prettier[/h1]
Our first drafts of the Adventure map were made quite a while ago and we pretty much got used to the gloomy, freezing and unfriendly environment, but we’ve recently had a change of heart and felt that a bit of eye-candy here and there wouldn’t do much harm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/0579790eb8a27a289eef5002fdd52b2093be42e3.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/4ea7dcc23c1ad9a1ddb79b43ee12782adb7eb5e0.jpg[/img]

[h1]Trees. Rock.[/h1]
Upon entering Bossgard (Adventure Mode) you’ll be properly greeted by a tiny forest! Geology has also enjoyed a bit of attention as well - rocks are now red-ish and blue crystal outcroppings have popped up across the world. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/0b9da487ba79e3f5057adb0d2b85ab52f398d2a4.jpg[/img]

[h1]Stats![/h1]
We’ve added a stat screen to the Customization Menu for both Vikings and Bosses. Check stuff like the number of played matches, number of wins and numbers of puny Vikings crushed. Also, bragging is free.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/52a5a11bdfbaca6e56383bc3e7b228705b0fdb83.jpg[/img]

A session summary was added at the end of the Adventure mode, it’ll pop up when you win. Or lose. Mostly when you lose. There you can see how much Gold you’ve earned, how much Fire Essence you’ve spent and even the total number of deployables you’ve used.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/952e7abf589157f3aac48c9ca5cbbbb68da5c902.jpg[/img]
[h1]
Welcome to the End Times[/h1]
A short cutscene has been added at the beginning of the Adventure mode with some fancy-pansy artwork. Spoiler: the world has ended before its time and Bossgard is a harsh place.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/06d424cce0d661d5ebe3bac47157ab1d1e0e9626.jpg[/img]
[h1]Balancing and Feedback[/h1]

Balancing the Adventure mode is a tough job because we want to hit that difficulty curve just right. We play A LOT of Bossgard daily and constantly tweak Elites, stats, Minions and a lot of other boring number stuff we won’t go through. We invite you to tackle the Adventure Mode yourself and tell us what you think. Also, if you find ways to cheese through the game, let us know!

Let us know when you get to the final Boss! 

Good luck!

notes.title: Update: Start Building!
notes.content:
Hey everybody, we’ve just expanded Bossgard with a nifty update: a Build Mode!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/16977e9059530fb58fbd98c98a8f74ce44c6b045.jpg[/img]

Are the breadmen too much to handle? Are the Drones swarming you to Hel? Is the Wanderer proving to be too much of a challenge? No worries! 

Build a Ballista! No. Better! A Cannon! Or several. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/3ae38e6684629dd73a6ed9b62e536a2e2130dabe.png[/img]
You know what goes nicely with Cannons? Walls. Go on, build some Walls as well. Bossgard’s an unfair place, might as well tip the scales in your favor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/af8146a333f9599125541ff88104eb4e17e7537c.jpg[/img]

Turrets, walls and traps can now be found as loot drops in Bossgard. They can pop out of barrels, broken down carts and all sorts of debris found throughout Bossgard. Just keep your eyes open!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/158cbd924794013299dd228b0ab7d4a241eb4155.jpg[/img]

Structures are built using precious Fire Essence, so it’ll be up to you to balance how much you spend on Heat and how much on deployable structures. Each to his own playstyle, we won’t judge!

[h1]Minion Levels[/h1]
Enemies in Bossgard now get stronger with time. They’ll be colored differently according to their power level. The… um, red-er they get, the badder they are. Easy!

[h1]New Bossgard UI[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/0af536da6e306dd24d5a0f94942c1149510c7e34.jpg[/img]

We reworked the HUD for Bossgard Mode. HP is now represented as a big green Heart, Warmth is represented as a Lantern and we grouped all the powers nicely together. Also player characters now have a model of a Lantern attached to their belt.

[h1]Level Up Shrines [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/5643e18468ef72180fe58980d17cabbd61c1c920.png[/img]
You can now level up your stats at Level Up Shrines by investing your Fire Essence in either Vitality, Damage or Mobility, allowing you to tweak the character to better fit your playstyle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/73efde2ccfb663ea93b0269c651db58a9b1d7d3f.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Vitality will incrase your total HP, making you more beefy.
[*] Damge... well, will increase your Damage output
[*] Mobility increases movement speed and dodge distance, making you more nimble.
[/list]
[h1]Work in progress[/h1]

We're still working hard on the system and a lot more is to come, for instance Spike Traps and Decoys, so stay tuned and do let us know how the new building system feels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/178ddca91e6927f7e53ab84cc96040e53d7cbc06.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/f8361cec83cbae3fd9a39fcabebc09d2419b1e1e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/0793c6826e7968607d9901f81117eb63e26a5df1.jpg[/img]

[h1]Viking Versus Viking Bots![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/5e9d06ed19464f5e5c55b23f5afe15a22403d304.jpg[/img]

We've also finished working on the new AI for Viking players, they'll prove to be formidable adversaries in Viking Vs Viking Mode. Try them out!

[h1]All in all...[/h1]
Besides this, we've also been doing some balancing here and there and of course, bug fixing. Again, if you stumble across any bugs, do let us know.

Please not that for the time being, these new toys are available only in the Bossgard solo mode, but they will probably be part of the PVP modes just as well.

Have fun! 

Bossgard awaits!

notes.title: Friday Stream, Update and Future Plans
notes.content:
The snow settles on Bossgard's frozen plains, Hel-O-Ween is almost over and while the Vikings are gathering for some well-deserved rest, the Devs are gathering for the weekly stream, but not before dropping an update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/27e5cd11fc6f75840b7ebfe13eff6ed877dadc2d.jpg[/img]

Before we give the patch notes, a few words about what our plans are for pretty much the rest of the year.

The short version is that we want to push the solo mode (Bossgard) as far as possible by the end of the year. What you can play now is a very barebones version, the combat is there, enemy spawn zones are there, the boss fight is there, but they're just proof of concept, a base upon which we can start building properly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/2588d39e53272eb568950df4ddc7e921f0f59cb0.jpg[/img]

If we were to describe our end-goal for the solo mode in a few broad strokes, we'd have to say that more than anything Bossgard has to feel a bit different every time you go through it while maintaining as much of the player's agency as possible. We want to reduce hand-holding to a minimum and try to give the player tools, rather than straight-up solutions to overcoming the cold, the enemies and the final Boss.

New enemies will keep bolstering Bossgard's fauna, new mechanics will be added to empower the player (e.g. a building system, allowing for deployment of turrets, palisades, traps etc).

The ultimate goal is to make this game mode playable in multiplayer as well, but that's still far off in development, corner stones need to be laid beforehand.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/5d335c9fccfa7380c389ce0fff830734e84af324.jpg[/img]

Long story short, the solo mode will be our main focus for the time being, but rest assured, multiplayer content will still be coming to Multiplayer as well. The remaining 5 Vikings will be added and more Bosses will definitely be part of the game by the time the game goes out of Early Access.

Without further ado, here's our patch log. If you're here for the stream - enjoy! If you're reading this from the future - we hope it was cool xD

notes.title: The Great Hel-O-Ween Update
notes.content:
The light grows dim. The air becomes heavy. Visions of an untimely end fill the minds of our brave Viking heroes. A few moments pass. Darkness engulfs all there is. Everything becomes nothingness and the black abyss of the night swallows all.

You are alone. 

Suddenly a chuckle is heard. Then a giggle. Laughter breaks out. The rattling of what seem to be hollow bones joins the unholy cacophony which now fills the air.

You know what this is. Everybody knows.

[h1]IT’S A PARTY OF COURSE![/h1]

The festival of Hel-o-Ween is upon Bossgard and oh, the gifts it brings! And what updates!

Here’s what’s up…

[h1]NEW OUTFITS[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/9f14b13c29e8b306bcf39c3632b0003a9f62c065.png[/img]

Each Vikings gets a new unlockable outfit. This year’s new fashion line-up includes:

Werewolf Innes - Unleash your inner beast and stick a tail on the fiercest archer in Bossgard!
Witch Asha - Who says mages are poor melee warriors? It’s time to cast “Smush” on your enemies!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/40bcdcca324be03187085998858549e9dd7104ff.png[/img]
Bunny Miko - This murderous rabbit is here to haunt and hunt its foes.
Gravedigger Magnus  - This mysterious stranger needs nothing more than its trusty shovel to best any warrior and monster.
Necromancer Edith - It was only natural for Edith to fully turn to her darkest side.

Every Hel-o-Ween outfit can be unlocked by visiting Hel herself!

[h1]SKELETON SKINS![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/68f89ca6bfeecbf52b302b3204c492c96a8df5d1.png[/img]
Dress up? How about dress… down? Who needs clothes (or skin or muscle for that matter) when you can enter the battlefield barebone-style. Literally.

Each Viking gets a new Skeleton skin that completely replaces the regular fleshy version. Make sure you visit your favorite auntie Hel to unlock these skins!

[h1]ENTER THE FROZEN WASTELAND OF BOSSGARD[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/b42a6236f361420e19fa0ded007f806da86558f2.jpg[/img]

The gates of Bossgard have opened. What lays beyond is a desolate land ruled by the great Evil Eye, slayer of Gods and destroyer of worlds. Do you even dare to step into its domain?

You can now play a very early version of our open-world singleplayer mode - Bossgard. This is a survival action-adventure in which you battle minions, gather resources and strive to survive while trying to unlock the area Boss. Great rewards await those who succeed, but be prepared for a challenge.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/e1be011824fd2e2c70af7837ecbb5a7c484cfbf8.jpg[/img]
[h1]Features:[/h1]
A third-person action adventure in the Bossgard universe.
Play as any Viking you have unlocked using all the regular powers you would normally use in multiplayer.
Survive the frozen wastes by firing up Fire Shrines to keep you warm.
Be prepared to get lost in a harsh environment that is hell-bent on seeing you undone.
Earn ludicrous amounts of Shards… should you defeat the Boss.

This is a huge new part of the game we have while working on the main game modes. It’s still in a super early phase and its pretty barebones, but we’ve enjoyed toying with it and we feel you will too. A LOT more content will come to Bossgard, but we’d really like your opinion on what we’ve achieved so far.

So far Bossgard is about hunting powerful creatures we refer to as Elites across a frozen wasteland. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/0aa2a0d8714976ac8b2100715aabf190b63cef85.png[/img]
When defeated, these Elites drop Evil Stones. These stones will allow you to summon the end Boss (should you manage to collect 10 of them). You must do all of this while maintaining Warmth. If either Warmth or Health drop to 0, it’s game over.
Minions will keep spawning as you play. In this early version they’re not that complicated or smart, but there is a risk they can gank on you, so beware.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/9003b4210e7ca5417657ccc9e31301233b4e5f41.png[/img]
As you slay Minions you’ll earn Fire Essence. Spend this at either Fire Shrines or Health Shrines to sustain your chances of survival.

We designed Bossgard to be a place that it’s easy to get lost into. The constant blizzard limits your vision, but there are landmarks scattered across the map that can help you navigate. Perseverance (and visual memory!) will help you prevail.

PUMPKINS!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/f0231aa982ba71e34c02c9a23eb3ef2a423e9578.png[/img]

Viking versus Viking maps will feature Trick-or-treat pumpkins which will reward or punish those that destroy them. Be prepared to enjoy a refreshing Rage Potion… or just as well be prepared to be crushed by a surprise Gorillabunny.

THIRD PERSON CAMERA (Mostest veriest experimentalest!)

You can now play Viking Versus Viking in third person mode. This is still under a lot of testing and there is a chance it might glitch (and annoy you) BUT it’s also quite cool and the game looks good, so we decided to let our players enjoy it. 

We’ll keep working on it of course, but you can toggle it from the Options Menu -> Input. As always, do let us know what you think!

So this is it, the big Hel-O-Ween update. We won’t shy away from saying it’s our biggest update yet. We added a whole new gamemode, added a new point of view for multiplayer and gave you all the much-needed themed customization items one might require.

BUT WAIT THERE’S MORE

Unlocking costs for new characters has been drastically reduced from 3-4K to 1k, so now after a few rounds you should be able to unlock new characters. This is a “special offer” of sorts and will last only over the duration of the Steam Halloween event. 

[h1]DISCOUNT[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/8c0980ce0381e264050b29e4dc23557dd2a65cad.png[/img]
Bossgard is 30% up to the 1st of November so this is the best time to get in the game. The host of new features and the reduced price make this the best time to get into Bossgard!

Right, now that’s it. We’ve really put our hearts and effort into this update and we would really like to know what you think and what you expectations are for future updates.

Enjoy the update, enjoy the event and hope you have a wonderful time in-game. Tell your friends!

Bossgard awaits!


-The Sand Sailors

notes.title: HUGE New Singleplayer Mode in the works!
notes.content:
Autumn is upon us and we deemed it only natural to answer to Nature’s seasonal changes with changes of our own, in the form of a series of huge updates. To that end, the tl;dr verison is this: Viking versus Viking is this week’s upcoming Multiplayer game mode AND a Singleplayer rogue-lite open-world mode is coming to Bossgard. Buckle up, it’s a long read :)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/68ab9d980185e6db6e7b2b48b2cbd04d3b461faf.png[/img]
[h1]Viking Versus Viking
[/h1]The Vikings are here to undo Ragnarok and set history right, but the war against bread continues and the Bosses, avatars of the ever-elusive Eye remain as much of a threat as before. As friendships are tested and new fellowships are forged, the Vikings look for new ways of tempering their fighting skills. 

And what better way is there to do so if not through a friendly bout?

Our latest update for Bossgard brings forth a feature we’ve been wanting to do ever since we finished our combat mechanics. Because hey, if 2 VIkings can fight a bread Boss, why couldn’t they fight each other?

That being said, this update comes with 2 possible game modes for Viking Versus Viking.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/03e409f9d6e0fc99c8af0117afdd6724e95f42db.png[/img]
[h1]Free-For-All [/h1]It’s each Viking for itself in this chaotic battlefield filled with skeletons, sentry guns, poisoned shots and feral sabertooth pets. Deploy every weapon in the Viking’s arsenal against your frenemies and make sure that Kill count goes up for you and you alone! First Norseman to reach a target score or to hit the highest number of points by the end of the timer, wins!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/04be03304dc4c6ac23f4cf143f5f768de6877fd9.png[/img]
[h1]Team Deathmatch[/h1] Up to 6 players can join in 3 v 3, 2 v 2 or 1 v 1 matches to settle to score and see who’s the toughest warband in Valhalla. All the usual combos apply so you can Gankorama, Sicken or Slo-Mo your enemies all the way down to Helheim. Split roles among you and find the optimal team composition!

[h1]Future game modes[/h1] The journey into Viking Versus Viking has just begun, Free-For-All and Team Deathmatch being our earliest and simplest incursions into symmetrical PvP lands.

Here are several game modes we want to bring to the game sometime soon. Remember, this is heavily under development.

[h1]Ragnarok Mode [/h1]
Two opposing Viking Clans have set up strongholds and are trying to raid one another, hoping to prove themselves as children of Odin. Waves of Minions march against the enemy Clan and brave Viking Heroes come forth to maintain the momentum of their faithful henchmen. Across the battlefield lay dormant Giants, waiting to be challenged by the warring Norsemen, so that they may grant their loyalty, joining the ranks of the stronger Clan. As the last stones fall from the besieged Stronghold, the losing Vikings fall prey to desperation and turn their prayers to the Evil Eye, who joins the losing side in the shape of a great Boss, in hopes of proving that true, evil power will succeed where futile bravery had failed. Should the Boss fall as well, only then will the most righteous Viking Clan claim dominion over the afterlife.

[h1]Features[/h1]
A MOBA-style symmetrical map but without the mumbo jumbo - straight up, fast, fun action
Neutral Minion Giants that can be defeated and recruited to join your war effort.
The ultimate comeback-mechanic - the losing team’s MVP takes on the role of Boss to make one last effort of saving the team.

This is still way under progress so we won’t expecting Ragnarok Mode to hit Bossgard for another month or so, but we wanted to let you know what’s in store for PvP.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/54aff373097b91b400d5dc7d85ea180128176c90.png[/img]
[h1]Open-world rogue-lite in Bossgard[/h1]
As you step on the cold stones of Valhalla’s corridors, way beyond the whisperings and mumblings of the Gods, you see a great gate, larger than any of the doors before it, colder than the most shivering Viking thoughts and stronger than the bindings of Fenrir. It is the only thing that separates Vikinghood and Godhood from complete oblivion. It is the Gate of Bossgard - the frozen wasteland caused by the distortion of the end times, the result of the Evil Eye’s meddling in Viking Chronology. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/51f8bc0481f69a49edeab9a7e6f4cf2a50ea8e97.png[/img]
After ages of battle against the Bosses, avatars of the Evil Eye, the Gods deemed you ready - ready to step through the Frozen Gates and into madness itself. Only by your hand can the Gods hope to undo Ragnarok and set history right. Steel yourself, Hero, the journey will not be easy. You will fall. You will fail. You will try again. And again.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/15183211c65ca33679c69751da542b098deb7730.png[/img]
And again. But blessed is your immortal soul for here, in Bossgard, time and nothingness are eternal. What once stood upright will stand so once more, even after a fall.

Rise again Hero, shake off the snow and dust and venture forth once more. The Evil Eye must be hunted down. History must be undone. But make haste, the Gods’ favor and warmth can only keep you alive for so long, lest you should fall and try again.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/6f52d67c5bb7cd000ff201554f96ebd0c32ed19f.png[/img]

Hunt for the Eye, defeat Evil itself and undo Bossgard.

[h1]Why we're making this[/h1]
Shortly after we set off to make Bossgard, we started thinking of how we could develop a solid, self-contained singleplayer experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/dc6e58c9172b40195979ce12a731b472bec8a884.png[/img]
We always wanted to create a part of the game that would be more immersive and more player-centric than the party-game aspect of it. We needed a play space where everything cooky about the game could come together and start making sense. Bossgard is just that, it’s Nordic Mythology, mixed with silliness and our personal twist. 

This whole new chunk of the game would have to be replayable and feature a completely different player point-of-view (3rd person) but would have to play out using the same combat system as in Multiplayer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/7a574c498ea15098f605fc8084fc31164f34f435.png[/img]

The idea of a rogue-lite quickly sprung to life and seemed the most plausible approach given our team’s size and possibilities. We started looking at what other titles are doing (and doing well) and we came up with a shortlist of features drawn based on other video games we look up to (including Risk of Rain, Warframe, Crawl, Dark Souls, even Gothic).

[h1]So here’s what’s coming:[/h1]
A singleplayer rogue-lite open-world experience where you must traverse and survive the frozen wastes of Bossgard in an attempt of locating and defeating the Evil Eye.

Roam the white desert guiding yourself using the landmarks, shrines and anything that can provide aid and safety in the face of adversity.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/0262bc441ae375763792860060efa07e77805b66.png[/img]

Locate the Guardians, defeat them and summon the Boss. Bossgard is protected by the Evil Eye’s strongest Minions, each with its own gimmick.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/ea85877f1353a14117fbb47185e575f10bea9432.png[/img]

3rd-Person combat / Bossgard features a new player perspective and is a spin-off of our Multiplayer combat system. Face the Minions of the Evil Eye in glorious 3rd person view! Deal Mighty Blows, deploy Shields and Heal yourself just as you would in Versus Mode.

The race is against the clock as you can only survive as long as the Warmth of the Gods is active. This wears out and you need to find ways to replenish it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/bed3d0eaa684b32ecd4eaecae77252c420c83851.png[/img]

Level up and upgrade your character. Various stats define your Viking, making it possible to adapt your Hero to your playstyle. But whatever your spec might be, Bossgard will challenge you on all fronts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/5b94006fea9bba2b560813176c903f4f2afb9fab.png[/img]

Bossgard is dangerous and roamed by various creatures. Some you have already met as minions of the Bosses, but there are many other creatures that lurk the wastes. But beware, the weaker you are, the stronger the Minions of the Wastes grow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/7aa2d76a329ca90380fbe374fd4364aa202f584e.png[/img]

Monsters are broken down into tiers and factions. Everything from hordes of simple Crumblings and Bloaters to specialized groups of casters, warriors and rangers roam these lands with one sole purpose: to see you fail.

What you earn in Singleplayer carries over to Multiplayer. The loot you get in Bossgard is yours to keep (should you make it out alive). There are also Bossgard-specific items you can show off in Multiplayer once you learn to master the Wastes.

[h1]All in all...[/h1]
As you can see our it’s a pretty huge chunk of gameplay and we’re striving hard to meet our own ambition. By the end, Bossgard should feel like a well-rounded game that can be enjoyed by a variety of players, in a variety of ways. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/f960e8d148fe71bb012d503190fc33a1f58c03e0.png[/img]

Do let us know what you think, we’ll make sure to keep you posted. Till then, we hope you’ll enjoy the upcoming Viking Versus Viking game modes.

Thank you for reading! See you in-game!

Bossgard awaits!

notes.title: New Update is Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32812278/7dce06d7a1b2aef90cda94931822bbb98c75dbf0.jpg[/img]

Another week, another update!

Today's hero is Mr Balance, who has been getting extensive care and attention. After maaaaaany hours spent in Bossgard's various formats (2v1, 5v1 etc) we tweaked, bashed and adjusted our heroes' and villains' stats to provide friendlier matches.

The first thing you'll notice is that several older game values are now dynamic, one of which is the number of lives the Viking team shares. This used to be a fixed value of 10 lives, but now the number fluctuates according to the number of players.

Fewer players will have fewer lives, more players, more lives - simple!

But the Vikings are not the only ones to get some love. After our many QA matches we figured that the way Bosses heal can be a bit much, so now the amount of HP the Boss can heal is directly proportional to the number of Vikings. So much dynamism, it's astonishing really. 

Stuff like Rage gain and Rage cost for the Bosses has been adjusted more than once. Some bosses like Plunger proved to be way too punishing, so we put their stats to the ax (read: nerfing).

We have also undergone several multiplayer and matchmaking patches so you should be able to find more players now, so let us know how that works for you peeps.

That's about it, hopefully all the patching will provide a much smoother experience.

Remember - we're streaming tomorrow so if you want to drop in for a game, stick around :D

As always feedback is paramount!

Enjoy the game! Bossgard awaits!

[i]Snail, on behalf of the Sand Sailors[/i]

Hi there!

We’re back with a new update, we’re continuing along the lines of our recent set of community feedback. The star of this update is AI, which got a fair share of love. 

Bots are now smarter and have learned to focus on the Boss’ healing outlets (Jack’s MULEs, Olaf’s Ice-Cream Cones etc) and have also learned to play a better support role. Bots will now come to your aid when they have Ressurect equipped and will also abstain from using lives from the Viking Life Pool if a Human Player is downed. This and various other tweaks promise to make Bots much more helpful. We’re still working on making them use their Shield properly.

Balancing has been and is constantly in our focus. Various Boss and Viking tweaks have been implemented (see them listed below). and Bosses should be slightly less punishing now, even more so now that Viking Bots do a much better job of keeping Boss healing in check.

Oh, and we have over 150 new icons for all the various customization items!

150+ new items icons for the Customization menus

notes.title: Update & Post Free Weekend Impressions
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32812278/6ae0a0a01011e5497683da7750b3436a0427a449.jpg[/img]

On Monday our first ever Free Weekend ended. It has been an intense, rewarding and extremely constructive experience. Eventhough there were several shortcomings, we enjoyed all the feedback and suggestions.

We spent our Monday going through all the feedback from the Steam Discussion, Discord and Email. The biggest issues were the mandatory (and difficult) tutorial and the lack of cursor for the Vikings, which we addressed immediately. The tutorial is now skippable and the cursor has been added on Sunday.

Balancing issues and bugs were present, no surprise there, we did our best to keep them in check. The most jarring issues were related to the progression system which received extra special attention over the course of the last 2 days.

We’d like to thank each and every one of our players and we want to assure all of you that we went through every bit of feedback, both positive and negative. Your playtime made a huge difference and that difference will be deeply felt in all of our future builds.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32812278/22462cfd53b747a2d0057ed4e6f9bf9a05e174ba.jpg[/img]
[b]Without further ado, here’s what’s new (ding):[/b]

The Tutorial is now skippable, automatically giving the player all the post-Tutorial loot;
Updated UI and UX for the Progression system; updated several Inventory tabs to better display the player’s Items and standing with the Gods;
Updated the whole rewards system so it better explains how Shards are spent and what you get after spending them (in God scenes);
Rearranged the Main Menu buttons for a cleaner design;
Enhanced feedback for Vikings taking damage;
Balanced Bosses for better damage output and health pools;
We updated to the latest Photon Bolt (networking) which should fix several “could not connect” errors people have been getting. Please let us know if things are better.
Tweaked Shard income.

[b]Known issues:[/b]
AI needs improvement as it doesn’t cooperate too well with the players
The game rewards players with Viking Items for Viking Characters that are still WIP
The “Tutorial”/”Story” mode is named “Play”. This will change.
The online playerbase is small

[b]Upcoming focus points include:[/b]
Adding the remaining 5 Vikings
UI/UX
A.I.
A full singleplayer experience, but this is still in a heavy design and debate phase

Long ways await us and we’ll definitely keep you posted regarding future updates. Also…

...We’re headed to Gamescom 2019 in Cologne, Germany! If you’re attending Gamescom drop by and say hi! Bossgard awaits!

-The Sand Sailors

notes.title: Update: Damage Numbers!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32812278/0786d2f203a6dfc72dc6fa4fd180b862f4d7691b.png[/img]

Ew, math. 

But math feels good. Numbers feel good. Big number feel good.

We've been talking about this for a while and our quest to provide our players with better, more accurate feedback has led us to the conclusion that numbers are, well, important.

So now every time your little Viking or giant plunger smashes another living thing, damage will be shown in big bold numbers. Take note that only successful hits yield the much sought-after numbers.

But wait there's more!

[h1]Introducing CRITICAL HITS[/h1]

This was mandatory since merely adding numbers with no variety in values felt stale. Now every few hits, based on a frequency of our choosing, your blows have a chance of being critical hits. 

(Needless to say this works extremely nice in combination with the Berzerk Rage)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32812278/19ffc6750d4973e7a5e57ffbcdf55581ee3fc2f1.png[/img]

We did it! A high level bug we've been doing battle against for the last weeks has finally been defeated.

A lot of our players have been having issues with the in-game cursor. It should be ok now, do test it out and let us know if it's ok now.

Besides the stuff above there have been valiant balancing efforts.

[h1]Up next on Bossgard[/h1]

Sure, damage numbers and critical hits are cool, but have you ever found yourself working on a massive overhaul of Bossgard's combat system to make it more deep and exciting?

Because we're upgrading the combat system, alongside a host of immensely awesome stuff (*cough* content *cough*) the next major update will arrive somewhere in the next 3 weeks.

This has been it, hope you'll enjoy the numbers, the crits and the now-working mouse cursor!

Till next time, a teaser: 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32812278/b286a54d50e3dae68049f911f9eb77c406349005.jpg[/img]

notes.title: PIMP YOUR BOSS - First Content Update!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32812278/6473e8e08ef91f505888dc0d50baef9cee400729.png[/img]
Check out the tl;dr video-version:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=owPOnzDzh2s
A month ago we released Bossgard. Today we’re dropping our first CONTENT UPDATE and by far the star of the show is the new BOSS CUSTOMIZATION feature! This is our very first milestone since the initial release and hopefully the first of many.

Without further ado here’s the feature list and changelog:

[b][h1]New Features![/h1][/b]

[b][h1]Boss Customization[/h1][/b]
Players can now customize their Bosses by going to the Boss Menu via the Main Menu (lower-right corner of the screen). Bosses, like Vikings, have various God-themed color schemes, which can be unlocked in Jotunheim, a smaller equivalent of Valhalla.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32812278/cfa37395bcf4c0b44c7165656968746198c6e22d.png[/img]
Bosses unlock skins by leveling up against the Gods. They earn points by defeating Followers of the Gods, based on what Rages the Vikings are using. For instance by defeating a lot of players using Mighty Blow, the Boss will level up against Thor.

Bosses have separate skins for Stage 1 and Stage 2! For instance Olaf of Bread can be yellow in stage 1 and green in stage 2!

Minions share their Boss’ color scheme! White Olaf - white Dumplings!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32812278/d8ebe9507687f21003f9cdd4a968d7df3759c1f3.png[/img]
[b][h1]New Maps![/h1][/b]
[b][h1]Lost Temple [/h1][/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32812278/465acf5ea80d1506917eeaf6f442ebb43f22886f.png[/img]
The ruins of an ancient temple become the next battlefield in the Viking - Boss conflict! Beware, the Boss can summon a nasty Ruin Creeper, a large insect-like creature with the ability to engage Vikings in melee AND deploy a powerful flame-throwing special attack.

[b][h1]Jotunheim[/h1][/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32812278/2b11e57e8fd5c4ddb60b9728b2df86d1315cd380.png[/img]
Home to an ancient and relentless evil, this new ice-themed arena gives the Boss the ability to rain down giant Ice Shards on the Vikings.

[b][h1]Tweaks[/h1][/b]

[b][h1]Multiplayer[/h1][/b]
We updated the Multiplayer menu to provide a more straightforward experience. Host, Join, Kustom Game and the Server List are now all on the same screen, accessible via the Online button

[b][h1]New Region Selection Menu[/h1][/b]
We are now allowing our players to choose their preferred multiplayer region to ensure that you and your friends have the lowest latency possible!

[b][h1]Balancing[/h1][/b]
[b]Vikings[/b] no longer build Rage when casting Berzerk or Ressurect.
[b]Olaf of Bread[/b] - Increased Ranged damage area.
[b]The Jackhammer[/b] - Incresed Ranged damage.
[b]Plunge D.[/b] - Overall increased damage output, but reduced the chance to stun-lock.
[b]Fortress[/b] - Lowered Minion health
[b]Viking Village[/b] - Incresed Rotating Fire Trap damage.

[b][h1]Fixes[/h1][/b]
Fixed an issue where some awards wouldn’t be given out correctly.
Fixed an issue where disabling XInput would break input.
Fixed an issue where clicking “Reveal” on new unlocked items using the mouse would not unlock them.
Fixed an issue where starting a game in Ultra Wide resolutions would disable resolution selection.
Fixed an issue where the Boss would not properly reset the game when leaving the match.
Fixed a bug where Maksim would show up fully white when his Morp Ability expired.

[b][h1]Tech-y stuff[/h1][/b]
Added support for ultrawide monitors/resolutions.
We updated to Unity 2018.4.25f
We updated our Bolt version to 1.2.8
We updated to Rewired Version 1.1.25.1

[b][h1]Misc.[/h1][/b]
Viking Bots are no longer customized like the Player.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32812278/9e3f82422adacbd2fb27a8211c0d293b64d4247e.png[/img]
We hope you enjoy this first major update! Bossgard awaits!

notes.title: Upcoming Content Update!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32812278/940f6fb5a67e6ec459acac90b2f8bcae3b337916.png[/img]
[h1]Hi everybody![/h1]

First off, a big “thank you” to our viewers from yesterday’s stream, it’s always great to have you around and we even enjoyed hearing some cool feedback and ideas from you peeps.

Our first Content Update is lurking around the corner. For this update we have several fun additions as well as some more technical features. So check this out…

[h1]New Maps![/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32812278/8ec11c39ce534fd910602cc8fdbe0b5aa3a335f3.png[/img]

Our update will bring two new maps, each with a different theme and new traps. 

The first one is an ice-themed arena, with a big bad dude lurking in the background. The Vikings will feel winter’s bite as sharp snowy peaks outline the edge of the battleground. When the Boss wills it, huge ice shards drop on the battlefield, crushing anybody caught beneath.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32812278/7d65d1d4d3e87bf351e9bb8a493e401ba517acf7.png[/img]

The second arena will be fire-themed, a lava-engulfed site of an old civilization, long forgotten, long untrodden, however not uninhabited. An odd species of insects, referred to by travelers as “Ruin Creepers”, have made these old stones their home. 

[h1]Ruin Creeper - New Arena Minion[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32812278/27f9312bdc0aaba26984763bf7f521738c77eb29.png[/img]

These creatures answer to the Boss’ call and when summoned will start hunting down Vikings, however their behaviour will be different from that of Valhalla’s Stone Guardian or Cute Arena’s Bunny. The Creeper performs melee attacks, trying to fill its Special Attack. When its Special Attack is ready, the Creeper turns into a large flamethrower. The Creeper is also able to defend itself, by guarding its front part of its body with its large front limbs. If attacked while defending, the Creeper fires an AOE attack, blasting nearby Vikings.

[h1]Boss Customization[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32812278/23316d700644eef1051ca1fd77121d0e2dd65605.png[/img]

Moving on we have a long-awaited feature, finally a part of Bossgard: Boss Customization!
Gone is the age of vanilla bosses, the time for pimping is now!

Bosses will get their own customization menu, similar to that of the Vikings and will feature several color schemes available for both Stage I and Stage II. Bosses with Minions, like Olaf and Fortress will find their small henchmen benefiting from these color schemes as well.

Players will be able to unlock these new Boss customization items in similar fashion to how Vikings earn their items. Bosses will earn experience through combat and unlock items at each tier.

[h1]Multiplayer Regions[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32812278/30624eaa558da1dafbd9c7a35271aae25a521a75.png[/img]
Finally we have a technical update. Multiplayer regions. Previously all connections were being relayed through a server in Amsterdam, which resulted in good connections for Europe, but less smooth experiences for players outside Europe.

Thus we have added a new Regions menu, so you can now select the closest server to you. Word to the wise, players will have to share the same Region in order to see each other’s games OR you can invite your friends through Steam and the game will do the Region switch automatically. 

This system should ensure less lag when joining public games.

[b]Anywho, this has been it, this is what we’re working on right now, the update won’t be hitting you people Wednesday as we had hoped, but it should be live in 10 days tops.[/b]

 Meanwhile keep the feedback coming, we make sure to adjust our course accordingly. Keep bossing and keep Vikinging! 

Love,
Snail, on behalf of the Sand Sailors
